Metadata.Title: The Test
Metadata.Description: This is the Ultimate Test. 5 targets have been selected based off the chosen fears of the indiviuals. You are required to take out these individuals by their recorded fears.Others that are in your way may be elimitated or removed. However, none can be found, you cant be compromised, and your targets must be eliminated with the weapons or disquises needed!Good luck! Remember you are the pinical research for Scarecrow
